verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same cramped leaderboard. The legal line is squeezed in tiny type beside the CTA and can't be read. The CTA nearly touches the bottom edge, and step 01 is jammed against the top edge. In A the logo sits centred over a left-aligned text column, so it is out of line with the copy, and the CTA crowds the headline. B is worse on spacing: its left margin is only about 12 px, and its enlarged coffee bag spills to the bottom edge of the canvas where A's bag sits inside the circle.
